items.title: Binance reveals hackers used fake job interviews, malicious code in $6.3bn heist
items.description:
Binance released on Tuesday a detailed investigation into the $6.3 billion hack of its cryptocurrency platform, showing how attackers used fake job interviews and malicious code to steal the funds.
The crypto exchange said it had replenished 98 per cent of the affected assets by drawing on its own funds, with the remaining amount involving little-traded currencies that are harder to acquire.

items.description:
Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik on Tuesday assured the public that the government will make utmost efforts to meet the demand for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) during the winter months.

items.title: Bangladesh garment workers stage fourth day of wage protests
items.description:
Garment workers in Bangladesh staged a fourth day of wage protests on Tuesday, with police firing tear gas to disperse demonstrators as unrest disrupted factory operations and transport links in the country’s vital export sector.
The unrest, which began on Saturday, has intensified despite the government’s move to form a six-member wage board to review pay in Bangladesh’s garment sector, the world’s second-largest apparel exporter after China.

items.title: Spanish footballer Jesus De Miguel dies after collision with keeper
items.description:
Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel died on Tuesday as a result of injuries he suffered in a sickening collision with FC Andorra’s goalkeeper in a Spanish second division match.
“Broken with pain, with a lump in our throat and unable to believe this is real, CD Tenerife announces the tragic death, at 8:00am (07:00 GMT), of Jesus de Miguel Alameda,” his club Tenerife said in a statement.
“No words can ease the pain, nothing can lessen this great feeling of sadness. Our thoughts are with the family, his close friends and Tenerife fans, who today are grieving over this terrible news.”

items.title: Entertainer and enigma, Glenn Maxwell bows out as cricket's great what-if
items.description:
Part entertainer, part enigma, Glenn Maxwell will go down in cricket folklore as the game’s great what-if a maverick shot-maker whose limited-overs wizardry never extended to red-ball cricket.

items.title: Soaring LPG prices force rickshaw drivers in Pakistan to cut meals
items.description:
For 13 years, Rashid Ali has driven a three-wheeled motorised rickshaw around Lahore.
His day starts at 6am and sometimes does not end until midnight, but he was long able to make around Rs1,700 ($6.50) a day, enough for his family’s bare essentials. Now, with liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) prices surging, he doesn’t even make half that.
Ali, 33, is among thousands of drivers who run their vehicles on LPG, which is sold in cylinders and mainly used for cooking and heating.

items.description:
LAHORE: A judicial magistrate on Tuesday granted the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) a further two-day physical remand of two suspects in a Rs35 billion fraud involving the online sale of counterfeit US postage stamps.

items.title: IHC suspends order rejecting FIR plea in Pims fire case, seeks inquiry report and govt response
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Tuesday suspended a Justice of the Peace’s order dismissing an application seeking the registration of an FIR into the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (Pims) neonatal fire tragedy.

items.description:

items.title: Maaz Sadaqat, Hasan Nawaz named in Pakistan Shaheens squad for Rising Stars Asia Cup
items.description:
